answer_1.quote: Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA), which aims to answer questions over knowledge base (KB), has emerged as a critical and complex challenge... we model KBQA as a semantic parsing task... QueryAgent step-by-step constructs formal queries with tools... We also implement QueryAgent framework on another semantic parsing task, namely Text2SQL.

answer_2.quote: We use F1 as the evaluation metric on all datasets.
